extracted.intended_audience: new and established authors seeking representation from Trident Media Group (authors querying literary agents)
extracted.subtask_description: Submission guidelines for authors querying Trident Media Group: how to send a query, what to include and exclude, simultaneous-submission rules, commission disclosures, and warnings about outside solicitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the query form and send to one agent only
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send a query letter using the form below to one literary agent only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided submission form rather than sending unsolicited emails; direct each query to only a single agent at Trident Media Group.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query contents — brief author paragraph, brief plot synopsis, contact info
rubrics_metrics.description: Your query should include only a paragraph about yourself, a brief plot synopsis and your contact information;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the query concise: one paragraph about the author, a short plot synopsis, and contact details. Do not include extra materials in the initial query.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not include manuscript/proposal/writing samples unless requested
rubrics_metrics.description: it should not include a manuscript, a proposal, or any writing samples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send full manuscripts, proposals, or sample pages with the initial query. Only provide those materials if and when an agent specifically requests them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete the form and agree to Terms and Conditions before querying
rubrics_metrics.description: Before sending your query letter, please follow the instructions in the area below by filling out the form and agreeing to our Terms and Conditions. This must be completed before an agent will respond to your query.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filling out the form and accepting the Terms and Conditions is mandatory; agents will not respond until this step is completed.

rubrics_metrics.name: No simultaneous submissions to multiple TMG agents
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not accept simultaneous-submissions that have been sent to other agents at Trident Media Group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit the same project to more than one Trident Media Group agent at the same time. Submitting to multiple agents within the agency violates policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: 30-day waiting period between submissions within TMG
rubrics_metrics.description: After the expiration of a 30-day period following a submission to a Trident Media Group literary agent, you may make a submission to another agent at Trident Media Group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait 30 days after a submission before submitting the same work to a different TMG agent. Multiple submissions made within a thirty-day period will automatically be blocked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency commission rates disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Our standard literary agency commission rate is 15% for sales in North America and 20% for foreign sales (in some of the small foreign markets outside North America the commission rate is 25%). The commission rate for film and TV sales is 15%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should expect these standard commission percentages for different territories and media; be aware of the agency's fees when negotiating representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beware outside solicitations — verify Trident email format
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not accept any outside email solicitations from email addresses other than Trident Media Group’s regular email format (@tridentmediagroup.com) nor online personalities claiming to work with TMG personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only trust communications from the official @tridentmediagroup.com address format; ignore and do not act on solicitations from other addresses or individuals claiming association with TMG.
